authorized_keys.name: SSH Authorized Keys
authorized_keys.command: for home in /root $(awk -F: '$3>=1000 {print $6}' /etc/passwd); do [ -d "$home" ] || continue; f="$home/.ssh/authorized_keys"; [ -f "$f" ] || continue; user=$(stat -c '%U' "$home" 2>/dev/null || ls -ld "$home" | awk '{print $3}'); while IFS= read -r line; do [ -z "$line" ] && continue; echo "$line" | grep -q '^#' && continue; fp=$(echo "$line" | ssh-keygen -lf - 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2}'); type=$(echo "$line" | awk '{print $1}'); comment=$(echo "$line" | awk '{print $NF}'); echo "USER=$user FP=$fp TYPE=$type COMMENT=$comment"; done < "$f"; done

sudoers.name: Sudoers Rules
sudoers.command: echo '=== /etc/sudoers ==='; grep -v '^#' /etc/sudoers 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^$' | grep -v '^Defaults'; echo '=== /etc/sudoers.d/ ==='; for f in /etc/sudoers.d/*; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; echo "--- $(basename $f) ---"; grep -v '^#' "$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^$'; done

sudo_groups.name: Sudo Group Members
sudo_groups.command: for g in sudo wheel; do members=$(getent group $g 2>/dev/null | cut -d: -f4); [ -n "$members" ] && echo "$g: $members"; done

system_groups.name: System Groups
system_groups.command: awk -F: 'NR==FNR{if($3>=1000||$1=="root") u[$1]; next} $4!=""{split($4,m,","); r=""; for(i in m) if(m[i] in u) r=r?r","m[i]:m[i]; if(r) print $1": "r}' /etc/passwd /etc/group
